hints.title: Subarray Partition Subproblems
hints.text: A valid partition breaks the array into contiguous subarrays of length 2 or 3 satisfying one of three validity conditions.

hints.title: Base Conditions
hints.text: Valid blocks: two equal elements, three equal elements, or three consecutive increasing elements.

hints.title: Prefix Reachability
hints.text: Let dp[i] represent whether prefix of length i can be validly partitioned. Check transitions from dp[i - 2] and dp[i - 3].

hints.title: Linear Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass checking 2-element and 3-element backward transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive recursive partitioning causes exponential 2^n branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP array of size n + 1 tracks reachability.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models valid partitioning using linear DP with constant transitions.
